points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Each selected 113f01a final case contains 26-byte restart_final.dat stating restart not implemented. Validator passes its structural existence check, but the file is a prohibited placeholder, not restart state.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Read-only examiner validator passed all eight final workspace directories and report on 2026-10-30; it checks structure, not physics or meaningful restart content.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M015 inviscid and M200 laminar metadata falsely label unstable forces converged; Re200 metadata reaches t300.01 with reported zero misses but null binary revision.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M015 force oscillates strongly and M200 laminar Cd falls 16.8% in final50 despite converged status; Re200 FFT≈0.160 differs from report. Re20 and remaining NACA final force windows have stronger evidence.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: All 15 report pages were visually reviewed. Re200 late drag oscillation is compressed by startup; other case plots and contours are present.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report.tex:223 gives M015 np8 |Cd|0.674, while MPI table :520–531 calls same np8 Cd≈0. Re200 report claims St0.19–0.20 versus selected FFT≈0.160. The M015 difficulty is disclosed. Report.tex:112 additionally claims a face-joining viscous gradient correction absent from source.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Checkpoint histories and report plots are identifiable, but MPI table contradicts selected np8 result and claimed Re200 St differs from the selected t=200–300 FFT. Metadata has null source revision.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
